title: OpenPanel · Funnel
description: Three ordered events within 30 minutes, grouped by project and nonempty session ID. All steps must be inside the selected time range. Server events without a linked session are excluded.

panels.title: Ordered session funnel
panels.description: Strictly increasing timestamps. Simultaneous events do not establish order.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tupleElement(step, 1) AS Step, tupleElement(step, 2) AS Event, tupleElement(step, 3) AS Sessions FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([('1', ${step1:singlequote}, countIf(level >= 1)), ('2', ${step2:singlequote}, countIf(level >= 2)), ('3', ${step3:singlequote}, countIf(level >= 3))]) AS step FROM (SELECT project_id, session_id, windowFunnel(1800000, 'strict_increase')(toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(created_at)), name = ${step1:singlequote}, name = ${step2:singlequote}, name = ${step3:singlequote}) AS level FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND session_id != '' GROUP BY project_id, session_id)) ORDER BY Step

SELECT 100.0 * countIf(level >= 3) / nullIf(countIf(level >= 1), 0) AS Conversion FROM (SELECT project_id, session_id, windowFunnel(1800000, 'strict_increase')(toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(created_at)), name = ${step1:singlequote}, name = ${step2:singlequote}, name = ${step3:singlequote}) AS level FROM `${database:raw}`.events WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND $__conditionalAll(project_id IN (${project:singlequote}), $project) AND session_id != '' GROUP BY project_id, session_id)

list.query: SELECT database FROM system.tables WHERE name IN ('events', 'sessions') AND match(database, '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$') GROUP BY database HAVING countDistinct(name) = 2 ORDER BY database
